senses.gloss: (b. h.; √סף, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp. גרר, a. אגר I) [to scrape together], to gather, harvest.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 3:3">Snh. III, 3</cite> <he>אוֹסְפֵי שביעית</he> those who harvest the fruits of the Sabbath year (for storage); ib. 26ᵃ <he>אוֹסְפִין</he> (opp. to <he>סוחרין</he> traders in fruits of the Sabbath year).

senses.gloss: to be gathered; to be taken away (by death).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (p. 257ᵈ ed. Amst.) <he>והם נֶאֱסָפִים לשָׁמְעוֹ</he> and they (the people) gather themselves to hear him.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Ib.</cite> (p. 258ᵃ) <he>בזמן שבעליהם נאספים מהם</he> after their teachers have been taken away from them (when they are dead); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite>; <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 12:11">Koh. to XII, 11</cite>; Tanḥ. B’haãl., 15; a. e.
